title: Chapter 241 - 241 You Know Lin Fan?

Chapter 241 - 241 You Know Lin Fan?

Chapter 241 - 241 You Know Lin Fan?

241 You Know Lin Fan?

Liu Gonglu and Manager Zhao practically jogged all the way into Feiyang Building.

Then, they quickly took the elevator and went straight to the main entrance of Flower Stem.

The beautiful woman sitting at the front desk smiled and said, “May I ask what you need?”

Manager Zhao said, “Hello, I’m Zhao Haibo from Qingkong Company. We have an appointment with your company’s Director Qu today to discuss the matter of Flower Stem’s channel.”

The receptionist looked at the record on the computer and said, “Mr. Zhao, Director Qu has arranged for you to meet in Conference Room 2. This way, please.”

After saying that, she walked in front and led Manager Zhao and Liu Gonglu inside.

“Sorry to trouble you,” said Zhao Haibo.

Creak!

When he pushed open the door of the meeting room, there was already someone sitting inside.

“Mr. Zhao, please wait a moment. Director Qu will be here soon,” the receptionist said.

“Alright,” Zhao Haibo said.

After the receptionist left, the middle-aged man who was already sitting inside smiled and said, “Why, if it isn’t Manager Zhao from Qingkong Company? I just finished talking to Director Qu and you came over? The timing is quite accurate.”

Zhao Haibo’s expression became a little ugly when he heard this. He said, “Did you talk to Director Qu?”

The middle-aged man was Chen Meng, the department manager of Runfeng Company.

Runfeng Company and Qingkong Company had always had a strong competitive relationship.

Chen Meng’s purpose for coming to Flower Stem was self-evident.

“Of course, I have.” Chen Meng smiled proudly. “Moreover, Director Qu is very satisfied with our Runfeng Company.”

Creak!

At this moment, the door of Conference Room 2 was slowly pushed open. A middle-aged man of medium build strode in.

Zhao Haibo, Chen Meng, and Liu Gonglu’s hearts suddenly tightened. They said in unison, “Hello, Director Qu.”

If it was a year ago, no, three months ago

When they saw Director Qu, they would at most treat him as an equal. How could they be so respectful like now?

On the contrary, it was Director Qu who should curry favor with them.

This was because Runfeng Company and Qingkong Company were even larger than Flower Stem back then.

In addition to the fact that Runfeng Company and Qingkong Company were handling the sales channels and promotions, Director Qu still had to work hard to build good relationships with Zhao Haibo, Chen Meng, and the others.

However

In just three months, the status of Flower Stem had changed drastically.

Flower Stem’s perfume and essence, especially the essence, were too popular. As long as their products entered the market, they would be sold out in an instant.

As a result, the scale of Flower Stem expanded rapidly, and the distribution companies scrambled to reach a partnership with Flower Stem.

That was because possessing Flower Stem meant possessing popularity and wealth.

“Hello, everyone.” Director Qu nodded.

Then, Director Qu looked at his watch and said, “I have a meeting in about ten minutes. If it’s possible, Manager Zhao, you’d better tell me the details of your company’s cooperation in ten minutes.”

“Alright,” Zhao Haibo quickly said.

Then, Zhao Haibo took out a stack of information and quickly explained.

About ten minutes later

Director Qu said, “Manager Zhao, I have to say something first Before you came, I had already reached a verbal agreement with Runfeng Company.

“Your company’s conditions are not bad. However, I’m not convinced that I should give up my initial plan and cooperate with you guys instead. Therefore, I can only apologize.”

After Director Qu finished speaking, he stood up and walked out.

When Zhao Haibo heard this, his face turned slightly pale.

Flower Stem had chosen to go with Runfeng Company!

This… This was definitely the worst news for Qingkong Company.

Chen Meng, on the other hand, smiled casually and said, “Hehe, it seems that our Runfeng Company is quite lucky.”

Then, he walked out.

Zhao Haibo was not willing to give up easily. He hurriedly chased after him and said, “Director Qu, Director Qu”

However, Director Qu ignored him.

Liu Gonglu said carefully, “M-Manager ZhaoWhat should we do now?”

“What should we do? What do you think we should do? I’ve already told you that today’s meeting is very important. You must be prepared!” Zhao Haibo shouted, “But what did you do? You were actually chatting in the car!”

Liu Gonglu knew that Manager Zhao was in a fit of anger. Moreover, he was indeed in the wrong.

Therefore, he could only lower his head and did not dare to speak at all.

At this moment, Chen Meng walked out of the office with a stack of documents and a smile on his face.

“Manager Zhao, I’ve already received the contract. Now, I’ll bring it back to the company to get it stamped and signed. Then, our Runfeng will be able to obtain a large amount of Flower Stem’s essence.” Chen Meng smiled smugly. “Manager Zhao, your business skills are not bad. What do you think? Would you like to consider coming to work at Runfeng?”

“We can’t work with Flower Stem this year, but next year” Zhao Haibo grunted. “Things might change!”

“Next year? Haha! Manager Zhao, do you think you can get the contract by then? Don’t deceive yourself!” Chen Meng sneered.

In fact, Zhao Haibo himself did not believe his words.

It could only be considered something he said out of anger.

However, Zhao Haibo’s words suddenly reminded Liu Gonglu…

At this moment

Lin Fan’s words suddenly echoed in Liu Gonglu’s mind. ‘If you struggle to reach a cooperation, just say that you know me.’

At the same time, Liu Gonglu thought about how he had learned from his classmates that Lin Fan was a well-hidden rich second generation.

Finally, Liu Gonglu mustered up his courage and said in a louder voice, “I know Lin Fan!”

When Zhao Haibo heard Liu Gonglu’s words, he quickly thought of the young man who drove them here not long ago and the conversation between the two.

He immediately felt angry. ‘In the past, I thought Liu Gonglu was smart and capable.

‘Now, it seems that he’s simply an idiot! Does he really think that just by mentioning Lin Fan, Flower Stem would choose to work with us? What a joke!

‘What if the company thinks he’s making a scene and chases us out?’

Thinking of this, Zhao Haibo was ready to scold Liu Gonglu.

However, before he could open his mouth, a series of brisk footsteps sounded in the distance, and a faint fragrance drifted over.

Then, a pleasant voice sounded from the side, “You know Lin Fan?”

Zhao Haibo, Liu Gonglu, and Chen Meng turned around to look.

In the next moment

The three of them were stunned.

The person who said this was not someone else It was Chu Yunyue, the president of Flower Stem!
